releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.33:
- Receipt Logo & High-Speed Thermal Printing: Inverted thermal logo with pure white paper background and 4.14% black dot density eliminates solid black blocks and prints receipts under 0.5s without thermal throttling.
- Cash Tendered & Change Due: Printed customer receipts now explicitly break down Payment Method, Cash Tendered, and Change Due.
- Bar KDS Full Keyboard & Touch Workflow: Glowing cyan border for active comanda, 1-9 & 0 quick select, +/- card navigation, View [Enter], Print [*], and Bump [Del] buttons.
- Clean KDS Headers: Removed confusing 'Type:' label and duplicate customer info. Clean Table and Server displays.
- Drink Name Preservation: Fixed regex typo so beer/beverage names (Modelo, Corona, Pacifico) render 100% complete without missing characters.
- One-Touch Quick Cash Tender: Tapping bill buttons ($5, $10, $20, $50, $100) instantly completes checkout with single drawer kick.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all 41 flight simulator vectors with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
